metadata.purpose: First non-lattice test model for the MacNeille reflection checker. The carrier {0,a,b} with 0 < a, 0 < b, a||b is NOT a lattice: the join a v b does not exist in L. The MacNeille completion adds exactly one non-principal cut {0,a,b}. The antitone map boxtimes has no syntactic fixed point. Under the correct L^op-closure extension, the sole completion fixed point is the non-principal cut {0,a,b}, giving classification nonprincipal-without-syntactic. Under the legacy antitone-dual-lower-cut-v0 rule, the checker wrongly reports the principal but unreflected cut i(a)={0,a}, exposing the wrong-polarity control case. This model is the primary regression target for antitone-dual-lower-cut-v1.
metadata.antitonicity: boxtimes(0)=a >= boxtimes(a)=0 and boxtimes(0)=a >= boxtimes(b)=0; no other comparable pairs
metadata.latticeStatus: non-lattice: join a v b is absent from L
